violation: Motion or animations are not reduced for users with the 'prefers-reduced-motion' setting enabled
remediation: Detect prefers-reduced-motion using CSS media query and reduce or disable animations accordingly
rationale: Animations can cause discomfort for users with motion sensitivity; provide a smoother, less distracting experience.

violation: Icon-only buttons must have accessible names
rationale: Icon-only buttons are not discoverable by screen readers

violation: All form controls need labels or aria-label
rationale: Users cannot interact with forms without accessible names

violation: Interactive elements must support keyboard interaction
rationale: Elements that are mouse-only cannot be navigated with a keyboard

violation: Use semantic HTML before ARIA attributes
rationale: Non-semantic HTML can confuse screen readers

violation: Async updates need aria-live for screen readers
rationale: Dynamic content will not be announced by screen readers

violation: Decorative icons should be hidden from screen readers
rationale: Decorative icons clutter screen reader output

violation: All interactive elements need visible focus states
rationale: Keyboard users cannot see where they are on the page

violation: Never remove outline without providing replacement
rationale: Removing outline makes it impossible to track focus

violation: Checkbox/radio must share hit target with label
rationale: Users may miss the checkbox/radio when they click next to it

violation: Inputs need autocomplete attribute for autofill
rationale: Users cannot easily fill out forms with no autocomplete
Incorrect input types cause confusion for users and browser validation
Blocking paste prevents users from using clipboard for common tasks

violation: Disable spellcheck on emails and codes
rationale: Users may be confused by incorrect spellcheck suggestions

violation: Keep submit enabled and show spinner during requests
remediation: Show loading spinner, keep button enabled
rationale: Disabling the submit button during loading confuses users
